x: Chandragupta II is credited in most notes as the first Gupta ruler to take the title 'Parama Bhagavata' (his coins carry it), marking devotion to Vishnu. ⚠ Sources differ: UPPSC keys (2009, 2015) name Samudragupta as the first, so read the options and the exam's key.

C is correct: Toramana occupied Malwa and central India (up to Eran) but the notes record no Indian ruler defeating him, while Mihirakula was defeated by Yashodharman of Malwa and Narasimhagupta Baladitya. Skandagupta fought the earlier Huna waves, and Rudrasimha III, Chandragupta II, Kumaragupta I and Samudragupta are not linked to defeating these two leaders.
